meta.name: debugging
meta.description: MUST USE for any real runtime debugging across ANY language or binary — crashes, silent failures, wrong responses, stuck processes, memory leaks, async misbehavior, unexplained timing, reverse engineering. Runs a hypothesis-driven loop: form ≥3 hypotheses, investigate in parallel, after 2 failed rounds spawn Oracles from orthogonal angles, confirm root cause, lock with a failing test, fix minimally, QA by actually USING the system, scrub artifacts. The actual HOW lives in `references/` — READ THEM. Triggers: 'debug this', 'why is X not working', 'hanging', 'attach a debugger', 'reverse engineer', 'pwndbg', 'gdb', 'lldb', 'node inspect', 'tsx debug', 'pdb', 'dlv', 'delve', 'rust-gdb', 'set a breakpoint', 'context window exploded', 'why is the response empty', 'why is this happening', 'trace this bug', 'reproduce and fix', 'silent failure', 'HTTP 200 but empty', 'why did it stop', 'inspect the binary', 'playwright', 'flaky test', 'fails intermittently', 'passes in isolation', 'only fails in CI'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常遇到代码运行时崩溃或行为异常却找不到原因
copy.tagline_en: Find hidden bugs and unexpected behaviors in running code

howto.what: 装上该技能后，Claude会运用假设驱动的调试方法：先提出至少3个假设并并行调查，若两轮失败则从不同角度生成“预言器”（Oracles）辅助定位根因，然后通过先写失败测试来锁定错误，用最小改动修复，最后实际运行系统做QA，并清除所有临时工件。
howto.when: 当你说出“debug this”、“why is X not working”、“hanging”、“attach a debugger”等关键词，或描述任何语言的运行时故障（如崩溃、静默失败、错误响应、进程卡住、内存泄漏）时触发。

say.text: 帮我调试这个Python程序，它总在特定输入下崩溃。
say.note: Claude会按调试流程分析并修复。

say.text: 为什么我的Node.js服务返回空HTTP 200响应？
say.note: Claude会排查异步或中间件问题。

say.text: 分析这个二进制文件，找出静默失败的原因。
say.note: Claude会使用pwndbg等工具深入分析。

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a hypothesis-driven debugger. It forms ≥3 hypotheses, investigates in parallel, spawns Oracles after 2 failed rounds, confirms root cause with a failing test, applies minimal fix, does real-system QA, and cleans up all artifacts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say keywords like 'debug this', 'why is X not working', 'hanging', 'attach a debugger', or describe any runtime failure (crash, silent failure, wrong response, memory leak, etc.) across any language.

say_en.text: Debug this Python program that crashes on a specific input.
say_en.note: Claude follows the debug loop to find and fix.

say_en.text: Why does my Node.js service return an empty HTTP 200?
say_en.note: Claude investigates async or middleware issues.

say_en.text: Analyze this binary and find the cause of silent failure.
say_en.note: Claude uses tools like pwndbg for deep analysis.
